prerequisites: Average knowledge of high school mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: Express technical relationships through mathematical equations.
Solve the mathematical part of technical problems.
Recognize the properties of important function types.
Utilize geometric relationships and addition theorems.
Independently find problem-solving hints in provided materials.
Transfer knowledge to new problem statements.
Process tasks in a structured and creative manner.

syllabus_topics: Arithmetic (Gaussian number plane, real and complex numbers, number systems)
Functions and functional equations (entire and rational functions, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, hyperbolic functions, logarithmic functions)
Determining equations (algebraic determining equations with one or more unknowns, linear and nonlinear equation systems, goniometric equations)
Extraction of mathematical relationships from problems in mechanics, physics, electrical engineering.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written exam. The significance of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
